name: Noe'ha'on
description: Noe'ha'on was a jungle world located in the Noe'ha'on system, a part of the Piryn Shar sector of the Expansion Region. It was situated in grid square K-16 of the Standard Galactic Grid and also lay on the hyperspace route known as the Great Gran Run, between the Kinyen system and the Mid Rim's Takodana system.
